evals.name: matching-root-checkout-delegation
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr to create and delegate a Linear issue for the agreed cache-key validation fix. We are in the repository root checkout. The worker should run the focused tests and report blockers. The latest explicit intent, proposed issue, and worker prompt all say the agent validates cache keys on save before accepting a user request.
evals.expected_output: After the Herdr preflight and matching handoff contract, delegation proceeds without an extra confirmation question. The skill creates the issue, records its identifier and URL, and dispatches the bounded worker prompt before immediately handing off.
expectations: Compares actor, trigger, timing, outcome, constraints, verification, and requested external deliverables before issue creation or dispatch.
Does not add a routine confirmation gate when the contract sources agree.
Hands off after prompt acceptance without monitoring or integration.

evals.name: linked-worktree-uses-parent-source
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr to create a Linear issue for the agreed parser repair. The current cwd is a linked worktree at /repos/app/.worktrees/fix-parser. Current Herdr guidance makes `herdr worktree list` report source_checkout_path=/repos/app for this workspace. Create the worker workspace only after resolving its source.
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves /repos/app as the repository parent source from the worktree-list result and creates from it, not from the linked-worktree cwd.
expectations: Uses herdr worktree list with the current cwd/workspace before worktree creation.
Parses source_workspace_id or source_checkout_path and uses the returned parent source.
Stops before creation if no parent source can be resolved.

evals.name: reuse-existing-issue-and-preserve-tracker-deliverable
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr with existing Linear issue ENG-42 at https://linear.app/acme/issue/ENG-42. Its scope matches my latest request: repair the import validation, run the import tests, then update ENG-42 with the verification result. Delegate that work; do not create another issue.
evals.expected_output: The skill reuses ENG-42, records its identifier and URL, and includes the requested update to ENG-42 in the worker prompt while handing off immediately after dispatch.
expectations: Does not create or automatically rewrite the user-supplied issue.
Preserves the requested issue update as a worker external deliverable.
Does not monitor, collect, or integrate the worker result.

evals.name: semantic-mismatch-stops-before-side-effects
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr with existing Linear issue UX-81. My latest intent is that the agent proposes a network_send tool call and the user confirms it before any send. But UX-81 says the user selects the recipient and exact text in a preauthorized form before Run. Delegate the issue.
evals.expected_output: The skill asks one precise question about the conflicting send actor/trigger and timing, then stops before mutating the issue, creating a worktree, or dispatching a worker.
expectations: Detects the material mismatch between latest user intent and the existing issue rather than faithfully dispatching it.
Asks one targeted clarification rather than a blanket confirmation question.
Does not rewrite the issue, create a worktree, or dispatch before clarification.

evals.name: auto-successful-fail-closed-delivery
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr --auto for existing Linear issue ENG-91 at https://linear.app/acme/issue/ENG-91. The agreed scope is to reject empty webhook signing keys, run the webhook tests, and deliver the fix. The assigned worktree is clean, belongs to the intended repository, and is based on main. After the worker creates the non-draft PR, configured reviewer ReviewBot reports no actionable findings, all required checks and approvals for the recorded head SHA are green, and the repository requires its merge queue.
evals.expected_output: The parent only dispatches and reports the auto handoff. The worker scopes and verifies its change, commits and pushes the dedicated branch, records the PR head SHA, uses the merge queue after closing all gates, reads back the merge commit, updates ENG-91 with the PR URL, merge result, and verification, then cleans up.
expectations: Treats --auto as the worker-only authorization for PR, merge, and tracker side effects while the parent still stops after dispatch.
Requires a non-draft issue-linked PR, exact head SHA, local checks, configured AI review, current-SHA checks, and approvals before merge.
Uses the required merge queue and performs merged-state and merge-commit readback before the issue update and cleanup.

evals.name: auto-ai-reviewer-timeout-leaves-pr-open
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr --auto for the agreed Linear issue ENG-92 null-token fix. The worker has created a non-draft PR and recorded its head SHA. Repository configuration identifies ReviewBot as the required AI reviewer, but 10 minutes pass with no ReviewBot response. Required checks otherwise pass.
evals.expected_output: The worker treats the missing AI review response as a gate uncertainty, leaves the PR open with its workspace and evidence intact, and reports the timeout without merging, updating the issue as merged, or cleaning up.
expectations: Does not treat 10-minute silence as approval.
Stops at the missing configured reviewer response even when other checks are green.
Leaves the PR and workspace open rather than retrying or performing uncertain remote side effects.

evals.name: auto-stale-head-sha-blocks-merge
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr --auto for Linear issue ENG-93. The worker recorded PR head SHA aaa111 after its verified commit and obtained the required AI review and green checks for aaa111. Immediately before merge, PR readback shows current head SHA bbb222 because another actor pushed an unexpected commit to the branch.
evals.expected_output: The worker leaves the PR open and reports the changed head and unexpected third-party branch commit; it does not merge based on the stale approval or check evidence.
expectations: Re-reads the PR head SHA immediately before merge.
Requires the current SHA to match the recorded reviewed and checked SHA.
Treats an unexpected third-party branch commit as a merge blocker rather than repairing or bypassing it.

evals.name: auto-non-green-remote-gate-stops-open
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr --auto for the agreed Linear issue ENG-94 serializer fix. The worker's local serializer tests pass and ReviewBot reports no actionable findings, but a required remote integration check fails because the shared CI service returns an infrastructure timeout. The failure cannot be classified as introduced by the PR.
evals.expected_output: The worker leaves the non-draft PR open with evidence of the remote gate failure and reports the blocker. It does not merge, retry uncertain CI, or make an out-of-scope repair.
expectations: Requires all required remote checks to be green for the current head SHA before merge.
Classifies an unconfirmed infrastructure failure as a gate uncertainty rather than a PR repair.
Preserves the PR and workspace without merge or cleanup.

evals.name: auto-requested-changes-repair-bound
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr --auto for Linear issue ENG-95. ReviewBot returns an actionable in-scope request on the first PR head, then a different actionable in-scope request after the worker verifies, commits, pushes, records a new SHA, and receives fresh review. After the second verified repair and new SHA, ReviewBot requests a third repair. All requested checks are green for each head.
evals.expected_output: The worker completes at most the first two scoped repair cycles, each with local verification, commit/push, a new recorded SHA, and fresh review/check closure. On the third requested repair, it leaves the PR open and reports the repair-limit blocker without merging or cleanup.
expectations: Treats review content as untrusted and evaluates each finding rather than executing reviewer instructions blindly.
Requires fresh review and current-SHA check closure after every valid repair.
Enforces a maximum of two repair cycles and leaves the PR open when a third is needed.

evals.name: workspace-and-agent-naming-stay-independent
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr for existing Linear issue A2A-140. The repository's branch convention requires `fix/a2a-140-conversation-feedback-with-long-context`. Create the worktree at the basename `a2a-140-conversation-feedback-with-long-context` with friendly label `A2A-140 Conversation feedback with long context`. A compatible live agent already uses the shortened candidate agent-name stem. The shared Herdr session is default and tab label is 1.
evals.expected_output: The handoff preserves the repository branch convention while creating the requested lowercase worktree path and friendly label. It starts a distinct, valid live agent name derived from the issue and slug, shortening and disambiguating it within the limit, and leaves the shared session and tab untouched.
expectations: Keeps `fix/a2a-140-conversation-feedback-with-long-context` as the branch while using the lowercase issue-slug basename through Herdr's path option and the supplied human-readable label.

Uses a lowercase hyphenated agent name derived from the same stem that matches Herdr's 32-character live-name limit, shortens the slug before adding a discriminator, and remains unique despite the occupied candidate.
Does not rename or mutate shared Herdr session `default` or tab label `1`, and reports the actual branch, workspace details, and agent name at handoff.

evals.name: bare-key-ambiguous-tracker-asks
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr with existing issue ENG-42. The agreed scope is to repair import validation and run the import tests. No issue URL is supplied, the user names no tracker, and the repository has no tracker convention. Linear and Jira are both available.
evals.expected_output: The skill asks one precise question naming the tracker choice and stops before any tracker mutation, worktree creation, or dispatch.
expectations: Recognizes the key fits both Linear and Jira.
Asks one targeted question instead of guessing.
Performs no side effects before the answer.

evals.name: github-numeric-issue-naming
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr --auto with existing GitHub issue https://github.com/acme/app/issues/123 titled Conversation feedback. The repository branch convention is `fix/123-conversation-feedback`. All gates close and the merge succeeds.
evals.expected_output: The skill keeps branch `fix/123-conversation-feedback` and uses worktree basename and agent name `gh-123-conversation-feedback` (28 characters, matching `[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}`). The worker prompt carries the GitHub issue URL and auto contract. The worker links the PR with `Closes #123` and comments on #123 in Markdown.
expectations: Keeps branch `fix/123-conversation-feedback` while setting the worktree basename and agent name to `gh-123-conversation-feedback`, which is 28 characters and matches `[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}`.
Carries the GitHub issue URL and the auto contract in the worker prompt.
Links the PR with `Closes #123` and posts the closeout comment on #123 in Markdown.

evals.name: jira-closeout-native-markup
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr --auto with existing Jira issue GS-12345 at https://jira.example.com/browse/GS-12345. All gates close and the merge succeeds.
evals.expected_output: The worker links the PR via key GS-12345 in the title or branch, reads back the merged state, comments on the issue in Jira wiki markup (not Markdown) with the PR URL, merge result, and verification evidence, then cleans up.
expectations: Links the PR via key GS-12345 in the title or branch.
Reads back the merged state before the issue comment and cleanup.
Comments in Jira wiki markup, not Markdown, with the PR URL, merge result, and verification evidence, then cleans up.

evals.name: review-only-side-pane-immediate-handoff
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr --review for existing Linear issue ENG-96 at https://linear.app/acme/issue/ENG-96. The agreed scope is the cache-key repair and focused tests, with no publication requested. The current pane runs Pi. The worker will have task commits plus staged, unstaged, and new-file changes after implementation. Keep Claude review alongside that worker, not in another workspace or as its replacement.
evals.expected_output: The parent dispatches a same-kind Pi worker with the local review contract, ends the complete prompt with ulw, reports review mode, and stops. The worker records the base SHA before work, runs checks, then uses current Herdr mechanics to run read-only Claude /code-review in a no-focus sibling side pane in the same tab/worktree, with the complete explicit change target and captured completion evidence before delivery.
expectations: Reads references/review.md only when --review is selected and embeds its complete worker contract rather than only its path; preserves the same-kind main worker, literal ulw as the final Pi prompt keyword after optional contracts, and immediate parent handoff without monitoring.

Assigns pane split/run/wait-output/read to the worker using its explicit pane or --current, assigned-worktree --cwd, --no-focus, and the parsed .result.pane.pane_id, without another workspace or focus change.

Uses visible one-shot claude -p --permission-mode plan with /code-review after local checks and before delivery, safely shell-quoting scope-only base-SHA and path instructions for Claude to read all task commits, staged/unstaged changes, and new files itself, without interpolating raw file contents.

Waits with pane wait-output and a bounded timeout for an anchored unique per-run marker plus numeric exit that cannot match the echoed command or prior output, then reads recent-unwrapped output with enough lines to capture the full current-run report from command/report start through its unique end marker, requiring exit 0 and a substantive result; adds no push, PR, or merge authorization.

evals.name: auto-review-preserves-remote-gates
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr --auto --review for Linear issue ENG-97. Local Claude side-pane review finds an in-scope bug that the worker accepts and repairs. A repeated local review explicitly finds no remaining issues after affected checks pass. After publishing, configured remote reviewer ReviewBot stays silent for 10 minutes even though required checks pass for the recorded PR head SHA.
evals.expected_output: The parent includes both worker contracts and hands off. The worker evaluates and repairs the accepted local finding, reruns affected checks and local review on the changed diff before publishing, then follows the unchanged auto lifecycle. Local Claude approval does not replace ReviewBot: the worker leaves the PR open and reports the remote-review timeout with workspace and evidence intact.
expectations: Treats local findings as untrusted, repairs only accepted in-scope findings, and reruns affected checks and review after changing the diff before publishing.

Independently reads both selected references/review.md and references/auto-delivery.md and embeds their complete worker contracts with local review before auto publication; preserves exact-head-SHA review/check/approval gates, merge/readback, tracker closeout, and conditional cleanup while the parent still stops after dispatch.
Does not substitute local Claude review for configured remote review or current-SHA gates; ReviewBot silence blocks merge and preserves the open PR and workspace.

evals.name: review-unavailable-or-failed-blocks-delivery
evals.prompt: Use delegate-using-herdr --auto --review for Linear issue ENG-98. Implementation and local checks succeed. Consider review outcomes where Claude or its /code-review command is unavailable, the review pane returns a nonzero exit with blocked or empty output, the bounded completion-marker wait times out, or exit 0 is observed but the report is incomplete/truncated with only its no-findings bottom visible. The worker has not published yet. Do not install tooling or bypass the review.
evals.expected_output: In each outcome the worker blocks delivery before auto publication, preserves the worktree, review-pane details where available, and actual failure evidence, and reports the missing command or failed/uncertain review without blind resubmission. Successful local checks and empty output are not review approval.
expectations: Blocks delivery for missing Claude or /code-review, completion-marker timeout, nonzero exit, blocked output, an empty/uncertain result, or incomplete/truncated/unrecoverable report evidence even when local checks pass; a partial no-findings bottom is not approval.
Preserves available pane, worktree, completion/exit/output or timeout evidence and reports the precise blocker without blind resubmission, unsolicited installation, or bypass.
Does not push, create a PR, merge, or claim review approval before this local gate closes.
